Thank you very much for your understanding, and for your help during my tenancy. Please let me know if you need anything further from me.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

Thanks for reaching out about the viewings — I really appreciate you laying out the options so clearly.

Just let me know roughly when viewings might happen so I can make sure the place is tidy before I leave.

Thanks again, and speak soon,
[Your name]

Dear Ms. Norr,

Thank you very much for your time and understanding. Please do not hesitate to contact me if you need any further information.

Yours sincerely,
[Your name]

[Your name]

Answer:
Dear Ms Norr,

I am writing regarding the rent charged for 1 to 8 June for the flat I rented from you.

As you know, I removed all of my belongings and vacated the property on 31 May. I was not living there at any point during June; the flat stood empty until I was able to return the keys to your office on 8 June.

I understand that our signed agreement states rent continues until the day all keys are returned, and I appreciate that you have charged only for the period up to 8 June in line with that. However, given that the property was unoccupied for the entire period and I had fully moved out at the end of May, I would be grateful if you would consider refunding the rent charged for 1 to 8 June as a gesture of goodwill.

If you are willing to do so, please send the refund to the account you have used for my previous payments.

Thank you for your consideration, and for your help throughout my tenancy. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your address]
[Your phone/email]

Note: Under the agreement you describe, the charge to 8 June appears correct, so the letter asks for a goodwill refund rather than claiming an error.

Dear Ms. Norr,

I am writing regarding my recent move-out from the property. I removed all of my belongings from the flat on 31 May and had fully vacated it by that date, meaning I did not live there at any point during June.

I understand that, under our signed agreement, rent continues through the day all keys are returned, even if the flat is empty earlier. As I was only able to visit your office on 8 June, the keys were returned on that date, and I accept that rent was therefore charged from 1 to 8 June.

If you are able to do so, please could you send the refund to my usual account.

Thank you very much for your understanding, and for your help throughout my tenancy. Please don't hesitate to contact me if you need any further information.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

Dear Ms Norr,

I am writing about the rent charged for 1 to 8 June.

As you know, I moved out of the flat on 31 May, taking all my belongings with me that day. From then on, I was no longer living at the property. I was unable to return the keys until 8 June, when I was first able to get to your office.

Thank you for your understanding, and for your help during my tenancy.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to withdraw from the spreadsheet course, as its live session is scheduled for 18 September, when I will unfortunately be travelling for work.

I understand from the enrolment message that the session will be recorded and that enrolled staff may complete it at any time during the following month, with the recording offering the same certificate. However, given my travel commitments, I believe it is best to withdraw at this time.

I would like to say how much I have been looking forward to learning the material, and I hope to have the opportunity to take the course in a future session. Thank you very much for your understanding and for all your help in coordinating the training programme.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

If you agree, please send the refund to my usual bank account.

Thank you for considering my request.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

Subject: Request to Withdraw from Spreadsheet Course

Dear Ms. Dorr,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request withdrawal from the spreadsheet course I am currently enrolled in.

Unfortunately, the live session is scheduled for 18 September, a date on which I will be travelling for work and unable to attend. While I understand from the enrolment information that the session will be recorded and that enrolled staff may complete it any time during the following month to receive the same certificate, my travel commitments make it difficult for me to commit to the coursework with the attention it deserves.

I want to say that I have genuinely been looking forward to learning this material, so this was not an easy decision. I would be grateful if you could process my withdrawal, and I hope to have the opportunity to take the course at a more suitable time in the future.

Thank you very much for your understanding and assistance.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

Note: (For what it's worth, the soil calculation was correct — 80 × 30 × 25 cm = 60,000 cm³ = 60 litres.)
